name: safe-copilot-context
description: A security-focused Chat Participant that sanitizes sensitive context before sending it to GitHub Copilot.

chatParticipants.name: safechat
chatParticipants.description: Sanitizes context before sending to Copilot

safechat.ignoreExtensions.markdownDescription:
Additional file extensions to bypass (never scan). Source code extensions (`.ts`, `.py`, `.java`, etc.) are already ignored by default.

Example:
```json
["myext", ".custom"]
```

scripts.copy-grammars: mkdir -p grammars && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-json.wasm grammars/ && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-toml.wasm grammars/ && cp node_modules/@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml/tree-sitter-yaml.wasm grammars/ && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-html.wasm grammars/ && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out/tree-sitter-bash.wasm grammars/ && cp node_modules/web-tree-sitter/tree-sitter.wasm grammars/
